trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task: work the seven stages in order and it arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the early story mission that opens the game. It is unmissable — play the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Unmissable; it may pop as Chapter 2 begins rather than on the last cutscene.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Unmissable story trophy. The name is shown here in the censored form PlayStation publishes.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Unmissable, and the game's second gold. Keep a manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, the Chapter 2 mission after which you can switch between Jason and Lucia. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Unmissable story mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. Unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but work done earlier still counts. The Long Grind stage of this guide lists the 35 items it needs.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. 100% needs 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. No mastery needed — one try of each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. At least one win per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts as long as the race itself is new to you.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and win the challenge against him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger questlines; it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, which is why it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18 spots). THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. Meditation spots show as purple icons when close; each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. 100% needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past 3.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app marks the spots; work through them as you explore.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress > Challenges; 100% needs 70 of the 80, and many complete on their own while you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bank vault jobs give you a 4-star level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this at the same time. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim (L3 and R3 while aiming). Pick a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle. Adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Back out toward the runway, take off, and fly about 1 km away for it to pop. Save first, the police come fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida (52 locations).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so it pops along the way.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No confirmed unlock method has been published at launch — this guide does not guess. Marked unverified; check the sources for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No confirmed method at launch; marked unverified.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there, since the partner trains alongside you.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No confirmed method at launch; marked unverified.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No confirmed method at launch; marked unverified.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No confirmed method at launch; marked unverified.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs and are laundered by selling them to your contacts. The total is cumulative.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties (8 garages). Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
